methodologyNotes: Adversarially re-verified 2026-06-18 via WebFetch on official pricing pages plus corroborating aggregators. Atera (atera.com/msp-pricing, atera.com/it-department-pricing) and Action1 (action1.com/pricing) return 403 to direct fetch; their figures were cross-confirmed via costbench.com, flamingo.run, saasworthy.com, superops, and Action1's own press release. Syncro pricing fetched live from syncrosecure.com/pricing (canonical term-based structure: Month-to-Month $209, 12-Month Term $179 per tech). Level (level.io/pricing), Pulseway (pulseway.com/pricing), NinjaOne (ninjaone.com/pricing), ConnectWise (connectwise.com/platform/rmm), and Datto (datto.com/products/rmm) fetched directly. KEY CORRECTIONS: Atera MSP Pro/Growth monthly prices were overstated and were corrected to official $139/$189; Pulseway's $22/device figure was removed (official page is quote-only, third-party figures conflict $22-$67/device) and set to null. NinjaOne, ConnectWise RMM, and Datto RMM are genuinely quote-only (monthlyUsd null). accessedAt 2026-06-18.
